## CLI Extension

New flag set (added to existing preconditions-ack.sh):
```
preconditions-ack.sh <story_id> --sample-ack --class=<degradation_class> --if-skipped "<rationale>"
```

## Sample-Ack Logic

When --sample-ack is present:
1. Load all PRECONDITIONS events for story_id; find all decision_ids where data.degradation_class equals <degradation_class>
2. Collect unique decision_ids from those events into an array. If count < 4 → exit 1 with message "class <name> has N entries; sample-ack requires >=4 (use regular preconditions-ack for smaller classes)"
3. SHA256 deterministic selection (must match T5 algorithm exactly):
   a. Sort decision_ids lexicographically
   b. Compute: digest=$(printf '%s\n' "${sorted[@]}" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
   c. seed=$(printf '%d' 0x${digest:0:8})
   d. N=${#sorted[@]}
   e. i1=$(( seed % N )); id1=${sorted[i1]}; remove id1 from sorted → remaining array
   f. i2=$(( (seed >> 8) % (N-1) )); id2=${remaining[i2]}; remove id2 → remaining2
   g. i3=$(( (seed >> 16) % (N-2) )); id3=${remaining2[i3]}
   h. sampled=[id1, id2, id3]
4. For each of the 3 sampled decision_ids, call validate-ack-rationale.sh with --if-skipped rationale against the condition_text from that decision_id's PRECONDITIONS event. If any fails → exit 1; no ACK written.
5. If all 3 pass validation → write ONE ACK JSON file:
   ```json
   {"decision_ids": ["<all N decision_ids in class>"], "if_skipped": "<rationale>", "timestamp": "<ISO8601Z>", "sampled_set": ["<id1>","<id2>","<id3>"], "schema_version": 1}
   ```
   (decision_ids contains ALL decision_ids in the class; sampled_set records which 3 were spot-checked)
6. Filename: $(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-sample-$(echo "$degradation_class" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')-ACK.json
